column1: # comment: "Five-facet software de-conflation alignments to DOAP, schema.org, SPDX, CodeMeta, ForgeFed, and Software Heritage. GMEOW rebuilds the distinction natively and bridges by reference (Principle 5)."

column6: Software Heritage Content is content-addressed file content; GMEOW Blob is the raw content facet (bytes only, no name).
ForgeFed Commit is the federated representation of a VCS commit.
Software Heritage Revision is a commit/revision with author, committer, timestamp, and tree; direct correspondence to GMEOW Commit.
ForgeFed Ticket ≈ GMEOW Issue (both are tracked work items).
SPDX Package is the SBOM-level descriptor; GMEOW Package is the distributable unit.
DOAP Version conflates release event and version string; GMEOW Release is the event facet.
Software Heritage Release is a named revision (tag); direct correspondence to GMEOW Release.
ForgeFed Repository is the ActivityPub representation of a code repository.
schema.org codeRepository is a URL literal; GMEOW Repository is a first-class entity.
Software Heritage Origin is a repository origin URL; GMEOW Repository is the location/hosting facet, which may carry additional metadata.
CodeMeta SoftwareSourceCode ≈ schema.org SoftwareSourceCode; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the abstract creative work.
schema.org SoftwareApplication is the deployed/runtime view; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the abstract creative work.
schema.org conflates source code and application; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the creative-work facet.
DOAP conflates endeavour, product, repo and history; GMEOW SoftwareProject is the endeavour facet only.
Direct correspondence: both are content-addressed files in a package.
Software Heritage Content is also the closest match for GMEOW SourceFile, which adds the named-in-tree aspect on top of raw content.
Software Heritage Directory is a content-addressed tree of files and subdirectories; direct correspondence to GMEOW SourceTree.
